newsitem.title: USA: Duke cuts output at McGuire 1 power plant.
newsitem.headline: Duke cuts output at McGuire 1 power plant.

text.p: Duke Power Co has cut power production at its 1,129 megawatt (MW) McGuire 1 nuclear power plant to repair a valve leak, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reported Wednesday.
The unit, at Cornelius, N.C., reduced power to "work on FW isolation valve hydraulic leak," the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The report did not indicate how long the repairs likely would take and the company was not immediately available for comment.
The adjacent unit number 2 at the McGuire facility, also rated at 1,129 MW, was operating at full power.
